issues.legal_issue: A railway administration is liable for a consolidated municipal tax assessed as a rate on lands and buildings when a government notification makes it liable for tax on lands and buildings and the consolidated tax replaces multiple municipal levies.
material_facts: The railway owned lands and buildings within the municipality and was initially made liable for house tax by a government notification.
The municipality later replaced separate taxes with a consolidated tax assessed as a rate on buildings and lands.
After the railway objected that the earlier notification covered only house tax, the government issued a further notification making the railway liable for tax on lands and buildings.

Government correspondence leading to the further notification showed that the municipality sought to make the railway liable for the consolidated tax, which replaced the house tax and a proposed general water rate.
Later municipal rules removed the exemption for government property, and the applicable municipal legislation retained materially identical language authorising the consolidated tax.
The railway’s successor sued to recover the consolidated tax collected from the railway; the High Court dismissed the suit, and the successor appealed.
issues.conclusion: The notification making the railway liable for tax on lands and buildings covered the consolidated tax, so the railway was liable for that tax and the suit for its refund was properly dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 135(1) of the Indian Railways Act, 1890, the government could make a railway administration liable for specified local taxes. Section 59(1) and its second proviso, clause (c), of the Bombay District Municipal Act, 1901, and the materially equivalent section 73(1) and second proviso, clause (c), of the Bombay Municipal Boroughs Act, 1925, allowed a municipality to impose one consolidated tax, assessed as a rate on buildings or lands, in lieu of two or more specified taxes. Although all taxes are not rates, all rates are taxes; a consolidated tax assessed as a rate on buildings and lands is therefore a tax on buildings and lands. The Court read the notification’s wording in light of the statutory scheme, the Rules, and the circumstances of its issuance, including the prior notification and the government correspondence requesting liability for the consolidated tax. Borough Municipality, Ahmedabad v. Ahmedabad Manufacturing and Calico Printing Co. Ltd. supported treating a tax in the form of a rate assessed on buildings and lands as within language concerning a rate on buildings or lands; Raza Buland Sugar Co. Ltd. v. Municipal Board, Rampur supported treating a water rate as a tax on buildings and lands rather than a service tax. Municipal Council, Cuddappah v. M. & S.M. Ry. Co. Ltd. was distinguished because it turned on different statutory and notification wording. Patel Gordhandas Hargovindas v. Municipal Commissioner, Ahmedabad provided little assistance.

rule.if: a_railway_tax_refund_dispute and railway_property_in_municipal_area and municipality_replaced_multiple_levies_with_consolidated_tax and consolidated_tax_assessed_as_rate_on_land_and_buildings and government_notice_covers_tax_on_land_and_buildings and government_correspondence_sought_railway_liability_for_consolidated_tax and government_property_not_exempted_under_applicable_rules and later_municipal_law_retains_equivalent_consolidated_tax_authority

predicates.a_railway_tax_refund_dispute: A railway administration or its successor brought a dispute seeking recovery of municipal taxes collected from the railway.
predicates.railway_property_in_municipal_area: The railway owned lands or buildings situated within a municipality.
predicates.municipality_replaced_multiple_levies_wi: The municipality replaced separate municipal levies with a single consolidated tax.
predicates.consolidated_tax_assessed_as_rate_on_lan: The municipality assessed the consolidated tax as a rate on lands or buildings.
predicates.government_notice_covers_tax_on_land_and: The government issued a notice making the railway administration liable for tax on lands and buildings.
predicates.government_correspondence_sought_railway: Government correspondence preceding the notice requested that the railway be made liable for the consolidated tax.
predicates.government_property_not_exempted_under_a: The applicable municipal rules did not exempt government-owned property from the tax.
predicates.later_municipal_law_retains_equivalent_c: A later applicable municipal law retained materially equivalent authority to impose the consolidated tax.

issues.definition: When a railway tax-refund dispute concerns railway property in a municipality, and the municipality imposed a consolidated tax in place of multiple levies as a rate on land or buildings, a government notice covered tax on land and buildings, government correspondence sought railway liability for that consolidated tax, government property was not exempt, and later municipal law retained equivalent authority, the railway is liable for the consolidated municipal tax.
